objective: Speak with Lord Jorach Ravenholdt in Ravenholdt Manor.

description: Lord Jorach Ravenholdt has requested your presence.  The matter is secret, and I cannot say any more.
Ravenholdt Manor is located in the Hillsbrad Foothills -- look for a path in the mountains northwest of Durnhold Keep.
completion: Welcome, welcome, welcome!  Please, <name>, have a seat and discuss a simple matter with me.
You see, <name>, I've recently lost something dear to me, and to put it bluntly, I want it back at all costs.  There's something in it for you, don't worry about that!  Oh yes, something very nice.
Now, what say you <name>... are you up for some adventure?
